name: web-illustrated-farm-tech-hero-with-monitor-and-phone-over-landscape
title: Flat-illustrated farm landscape with a blue app hero on a monitor and a phone overlapping it
whatItIs: A bright flat-vector scene of hills, clouds, wind turbines and farmers. A monitor shows a blue hero 'Farming Made Simple, Smart & Fully Connected' with a floating drone and a pill nav, and a phone overlaps it with a farm dashboard.
whatItMeans: Friendly and optimistic; the illustrated world flows straight into the UI.
techniques: Continue an illustrated landscape into the screen.
Let a phone overlap the monitor.
Use one blue hero with a drone illustration.
Keep the UI pill nav clean.

vocabulary.definition: An illustration in flat shapes without outlines.
A backdrop that matches the screen imagery.
A phone placed over a monitor.
